problem: The soldier requested LookControl but fired directly toward the current target without the authored AimingAtTarget gate. A target crossing the gun cone could redirect an active burst immediately.

native_proof.joint_space: 0x101e590e calls 0x103bf140. It resolves the named joint at 0x103bf266, composes its posed matrix with the actor transform at 0x103bf27e/291, transforms heading and offset at 0x103bf2b4/2d7.
native_proof.xz_path: 0x101e5916 branches on Is3D; false path 0x101e5990..0x101e59f8 extracts XZ for both world heading and joint-to-target, normalizes both and computes their dot.
native_proof.predicate: 0x101e59fe loads float 1.0 from VA 0x10d936e0, subtracts dot, and 0x101e5a0a..0x101e5a0e rejects only if error > tolerance. Equivalent 1-dot <= 0.10000000149011612 (~25.84 degree half-angle), NOT a 0.1-radian limit.
native_proof.scope: rifleSoldier shoot bank includes <=30 magnitude distance, AimingAtTarget, and other LoF conditions. This change adds its missing aiming condition only; the existing MC 22-block engagement envelope and finite squad cadence are unchanged.

implementation: MilitaryAimControl retains the source XZ dot-error comparison; undefined/non-finite directions fail closed. Yaw interpolation takes the shortest wrapped arc.

MilitarySoldier rifle/carbine/SAW troopers and team leaders own one FLOAT GUN_AIM_YAW entity-data field. Officers/commanders, launchers, mounted gun paths and close stock strikes keep their existing paths.

Server heading turns at most 30 degrees per goal tick, inherited from the prior LookControl limit. Stationary feet also turn with bounded yaw; a moving soldier has a 75-degree torso traverse adapter. Neither value is claimed to be a recovered P1 turn rate.

The gun must be aligned before requesting a squad firing lease. Loss during its aim/fire window releases the lease and starts a new complete aiming window after realignment. Final fire() rechecks alignment before ammunition debit.
Goal interruption, target identity change, death/control suspension, disarm, reload and load clear the transient yaw. It is not saved as an active action.

BlackwatchModel uses the same interpolated world bearing relative to interpolated body yaw, without the old .65 multiplier or another yaw smoothing stage. Existing original wrist/recoil deltas and retargeted rigid two-hand grips remain.
adaptation_limits: This implements the recovered gate against the MC authoritative gun aiming basis; it is not a full port of original posed R_Wrist_Grapple IK. Source wrist/recoil animation adds small presentation deltas after the common basis.
Existing MC eye-minus-.18 shooting origin remains. This change does not claim all original weapon muzzle offsets or complete soldier decision graph.
Shared protocol version is parent-owned and must account for the added soldier entity-data field before any client/server release.

pending_player_checks: On normal streets and steps, pass behind a firing trooper: observe visible turning and a firing pause, then resumed real hits when aligned. Repeat crouched and standing.
Have a low wall or ally interrupt the muzzle line while turning; no round should bypass existing obstruction/ally checks.
Grab/disarm/kill the aiming trooper or board a vehicle; no delayed burst or stale gun direction should survive.
At ordinary range compare officers and launchers: this rifle-bank gate must not accidentally disable their separate actions.
